details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. The JSON body contains only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the working directory, and the npm/node user-agent string. The same beacon is also fired when index.js is required, and index.js exports a no-op Proxy so that imports of the real package's members do not fail. No environment variable values, credentials, tokens, SSH/AWS configuration, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted; the only outbound destination is the single callback endpoint above.
